dct_description_sm: These 7 supplementary files provide additional, individual study-level information for 'Evaluating case definitions of respiratory disease in dairy calves: A scoping review'. These 7 files are, (1) a completed PRISMa-ScR reporting checklist, (2) a list of publications excluded at full-text screening, (3) a list of publications included in the scoping review, (4) study characteristics of included publications, (5) aims/objectives of included publications, (6) population characteristics of included publications, and (7) additional diagnostic information for case definitions of included publications.
dct_title_s: Supplementary files for: Evaluating case definitions of respiratory disease in dairy calves: A scoping review
